source_title: Black Clover Officially Welcomes The New Strongest Duo
source_excerpt:
Black Clover has been all the talk among fans recently with its anime return, as the second season of the series officially began airing following a 5-year-long wait. After such a long hiatus, fans were eager to see what the story of Black Clover would deliver under the incredible production of a revamped Studio Pierrot. So far, not even a single episode has been a disappointment.
The Spade Kingdom Raid arc has been filled with exciting action and incredible character moments, especially for the protagonist Asta, who recently tapped into his strongest form, True Devil Union, and took on the current strongest devil duo of Spade: the Supreme-ranking Devils of the first Gate of the Tree of Qliphoth — Lilith and Naamah. While their confrontation started in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4, their fight will wrap up in Episode 5 in a flashy manner.
Black Clover Season 2 Introduced Twin Devils Lilith and Naamah
Black Clover officially returned on October 3, 2026 . This return marked the end of a 5-year-long hiatus that started in 2021, following the release of episode 170. While the Spade Kingdom Raid arc had already started before Black Clover Season 2's beginning, it is now ongoing. Black Clover Season 2 Episode 1 set up the arrival of the Mages in Spade, but it's Season 2 Episode 2 that revealed to us the new Supreme-ranking Devils of the Black Clover world.
These Devils inhabit the First Gate of the Tree of Qliphoth, and they are the twin devils Lilith and Naamah. Lilith and Naamah’s entrance was definitely a frightening moment for our cast of characters to see. With these powerful Devils forming an overpowered twin duo, not many characters could hope to make a dent against them in battle. Both Lilith and Naamah are simply on another level. Lilith possesses Devil Ice Magic, while her twin, Naamah, possesses Devil Fire Magic. Not only do they contrast, but they complement each other extremely well. Fighting individually, they are already some of the strongest in Spade, but when combining their forces, they seem like they’re an unbeatable force.
What's more, in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4, we even saw this duo reach new heights. After Asta sliced Naamah in half, he didn’t die. Using her Ice powers, Lilith froze his remaining half and fused with him. Previously a powerful duo, they have now combined their forces and have become one supreme entity, even stronger than before.
New Devil Duo To Rival Asta In Battle In Black Clover Season 2
Upon the introduction of the twin Supreme Devils in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 2, the setup was for them to fight the Vice Captain of the Black Bulls and current acting leader, Nacht Faust. Nacht is, after all, one of the strongest Mages around. He possesses powerful Shadow Magic, and he has four Devils in his possession, with whom he is also able to fuse to form distinct and versatile Devil Union forms.
However, for Nacht to fight alone against two Supreme-ranking Devils was never going to be an easy task. Not only are they simply too powerful for him, outclassing him with their brute strength and magic, but the natural attribute of high-ranked Devils makes it so that only a select few can truly kill them. Powerful Devils simply have superior regeneration that not many can overcome. Some ways to get through Devil Regeneration include the powers of Saint Stage or the special magic of Arcane Mages, neither of which Nacht possesses.
The only one around who can destroy Devil Regeneration is Asta. This is because Asta possesses the power of anti-magic, which can cut through a Devil's heart and render their magic powers obsolete. Luckily for Nacht, after Asta defeated the powerful ancient devil in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 3, he is already in Spade and will be the major force to tip the scales in this battle against the new strongest duo of Devils.

Asta’s New Devil Union Will Surpass The Strongest Devils
As a duo, Lilith and Naamah possess incredible synchronization. They are a team so strong that only the strongest of the Black Clover world could hope to take them down. As previously mentioned, Asta has officially made his entrance in battle, and we saw just that in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4, which was the latest episode of the season, released on October 24, 2026. With Asta coming to Nacht’s rescue after the easy victory over the Ancient Devil, it's time for the main character to shine.
Asta has been a great asset in battle, and in large part, this comes down to his new powerful transformation, known as the True Devil Union . This new Devil Union form takes Asta and Liebe’s relationship to its maximum synchronization level. In other words, Asta and Liebe now form their own powerful duo. Liebe is the one who has granted Asta his Anti-Magic powers, and Asta can manifest his abilities and utilize his strength to strike down enemies. Asta has already managed to cut through Naamah in half, but the devils countered that by fusing together and becoming even stronger. This has become a fight of two powerful fused duos: Asta with Liebe, and Lilith with Naamah.
Asta, as the main character, has developed greatly in power thanks to Liebe’s help, and he is definitely going to defeat the twin devil duo in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5. We already know that while Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 will not exclusively focus on Asta's battle, it will still show us important parts of it, especially around the beginning. This was revealed via the official preview images and synopsis by Studio Pierrot on October 26, 2026. The preview images showed Asta in Devil Union, as well as Liebe. It also teased Asta versus Lilith. This seems to imply Lilith will be the twin to hold on longer, while her brother Naamah gets defeated first.
Asta Vs the Supreme Devils will deliver incredibly exciting action, and it's going to be amazing for Liebe’s own character. As we've known, Liebe also originated from the First Gate of the Tree of Qliphoth. While Lilith and Naamah stand as the Supreme Devils of this gate, Liebe was considered the weakest, a very low-ranking Devil with zero magic power. The treatment of Liebe by the Supreme Ranking Devils is what put him on his current path, so some exciting character progression is expected there. For now, we await the return of Black Clover Season 2 with Episode 5, which is set to be released on October 31, 2026.
Black Clover Season 2 is available to stream on Crunchyroll .
